newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Chicago market swings keep lid on European feeds.
newsitem.headline: Chicago market swings keep lid on European feeds.

text.p: A volatile Chicago futures market kept a led on European physical buying on Tuesday, with only a handful of trades reported on the continent.
Traders said the firm close on Chicago on Monday, followed by sharp losses on Project A overnight had sapped confidence from European players, who saw the advent of a "weather market".
"The moves were just too much. Everybody here is quite sure we are entering a weather market," one trader said.
A few trades in afloat Argentine sunmeal and soymeal were reported, all of which fetched earlier asking prices.
